Saved tree model inference.

Loads a native CyxWiz tree-family model artifact and appends a prediction column.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `TreeModelPredictor` |
| Search words | tree, model, predict, predictor, inference, artifact, classic ml |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table with compatible numeric feature columns |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Predictions** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus prediction column |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Artifact | Model path | `model_path` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Saved JSON tree-family artifact to load. Required. |
| Columns | Feature columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated numeric features; empty uses the artifact's saved feature order. |
| Output | Prediction column | `prediction_col` | Text | `prediction` |   | The run | Name of the appended prediction column. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
